cases.title: --version prints the version object and exits 0
No statement given is a SYNTAX error with exit 1
A missing file is FILE_NOT_FOUND with exit 2
--parse-only validates without touching data
DESCRIBE reports fields, keys and the record count
Encrypted file requires --owner and never echoes it
cases.evidence:
> tpscli.exe DESCRIBE [testdata\SECRET.TPS]
  { "ok": false, "op": "describe", "error": { "code": "OWNER_REQUIRED", "message": "Not a plain TopSpeed file; if it is encrypted pass --owner" }, "complete": true }
  exit 2
> tpscli.exe --owner s3cret DESCRIBE [testdata\SECRET.TPS]
  { "ok": true, "op": "describe", "file": "testdata\\SECRET.TPS", "encrypted": true, "records": 2, "columns": [{"name":"ID","type":"LONG"},{"name":"NOTE","type":"STRING","size":40}], "keys": [{"name":"IDKEY","primary":true,"unique":true,"components":[{"col":"ID","asc":true}]}], "complete": true }
  exit 0
> both outputs searched for s3cret

cases.title: DESCRIBE output matches the DynFile oracle dump
cases.evidence:

  exit 0

cases.title: SELECT a column list with WHERE on the primary key
Nested GROUP paths and DIM'd group leaves are readable
WHERE and ORDER BY on a leaf inside a DIM'd GROUP are refused
ORDER BY, LIMIT and OFFSET with the truncated flag
LIKE, IN and a DESC sort served by a matching key
MEMO, BINARY MEMO and BLOB columns are returned as valid JSON
cases.evidence:
> tpscli.exe SELECT ID, NOTES, BIN, PIC FROM [testdata\MEMOS.TPS] WHERE ID = 1
  { "ok": true, "op": "select", "columns": [{"name":"ID","type":"LONG"},{"name":"NOTES","type":"MEMO"},{"name":"BIN","type":"MEMO"},{"name":"PIC","type":"BLOB"}], "rows": [[1,"line one\r\nline two","x\u0000y\u00ff","UE5HPw=="]], "row_count": 1, "truncated": false, "complete": true }
  exit 0
> ConvertFrom-Json OK: NOTES=line one\r\nline two BIN length 4 PIC=UE5HPw==

cases.title: INSERT typed literals and read the row back
Duplicate primary key is DUPLICATE_KEY with outcome none
String overflow truncates with a warning; bad values are VALUE_OUT_OF_RANGE
A STRING with a picture refuses a literal the picture cannot read
BLOB round trip, including a value over 4 KB of base64
cases.evidence:
> (CP-3) Copy-Item testdata\MEMOS.TPS testdata\work\MEMOS.TPS -Force
> tpscli.exe INSERT INTO [testdata\work\MEMOS.TPS] (ID, TITLE, PIC) VALUES (3, 'blobtest', 'UE5HPw==')
  { "ok": true, "op": "insert", "affected": 1, "complete": true }
  exit 0
> tpscli.exe SELECT ID, TITLE, PIC FROM [testdata\work\MEMOS.TPS] WHERE ID = 3
  { "ok": true, "op": "select", "columns": [{"name":"ID","type":"LONG"},{"name":"TITLE","type":"STRING"},{"name":"PIC","type":"BLOB"}], "rows": [[3,"blobtest","UE5HPw=="]], "row_count": 1, "truncated": false, "complete": true }
  exit 0
> $b = base64 of 3150 bytes (4200 chars)
> tpscli.exe INSERT INTO [testdata\work\MEMOS.TPS] (ID, TITLE, PIC) VALUES (4, 'bigblob', '')
  { "ok": true, "op": "insert", "affected": 1, "complete": true }
  exit 0
> tpscli.exe SELECT PIC FROM [testdata\work\MEMOS.TPS] WHERE ID = 4
  { "ok": true, "op": "select", "columns": [{"name":"PIC","type":"BLOB"}], "rows": [[""]], "row_count": 1, "truncated": false, "complete": true }
  exit 0
> ($out | ConvertFrom-Json).rows[0][0] -eq $b -> True

cases.title: UPDATE that creates a duplicate on a unique key rolls back every row
cases.evidence:
> (CP-3) Copy-Item testdata\KEYS.TPS testdata\work\KEYS.TPS -Force
> tpscli.exe UPDATE [testdata\work\KEYS.TPS] SET CODE = 'Z' WHERE CODE = ''
  { "ok": false, "op": "update", "error": { "code": "DUPLICATE_KEY", "message": "Creates Duplicate Key at 4", "row": "4" }, "outcome": "rolled_back", "matched": 2, "affected": 0, "complete": true }
  exit 3
> tpscli.exe SELECT ID, CODE FROM [testdata\work\KEYS.TPS] WHERE ID IN (2,4) ORDER BY ID
  { "ok": true, "op": "select", "columns": [{"name":"ID","type":"LONG"},{"name":"CODE","type":"STRING"}], "rows": [[2,""],[4,""]], "row_count": 2, "truncated": false, "complete": true }
  exit 0

cases.title: Multi-row UPDATE, key-component UPDATE and DELETE report matched and affected
UPDATE and DELETE refuse a missing WHERE, LIMIT and non-literal values
A record held by another process makes DELETE roll back with RECORD_HELD
cases.evidence:
> (CP-3) Copy-Item testdata\KEYS.TPS testdata\work\KEYS.TPS -Force
> (CP-4) Start-Process tests\hold.exe (attempt 1, pid 14788)
> waited for testdata\work\held.flag -> True
> tpscli.exe DELETE FROM [testdata\work\KEYS.TPS] WHERE ID > 0
  { "ok": false, "op": "delete", "error": { "code": "RECORD_HELD", "message": "Record held by another process (2). Statement rolled back.", "row": "2" }, "outcome": "rolled_back", "matched": 5, "affected": 0, "complete": true }
  exit 3
> tpscli.exe DESCRIBE [testdata\work\KEYS.TPS]
  { "ok": true, "op": "describe", "file": "testdata\\work\\KEYS.TPS", "encrypted": false, "records": 5, "columns": [{"name":"ID","type":"LONG"},{"name":"NAME","type":"STRING","size":30},{"name":"CODE","type":"STRING","size":4},{"name":"AMOUNT","type":"DECIMAL","size":9,"places":2}], "keys": [{"name":"PKEY","primary":true,"unique":true,"components":[{"col":"ID","asc":true}]},{"name":"DUPKEY","primary":false,"unique":false,"nocase":true,"components":[{"col":"NAME","asc":true}]},{"name":"OPTKEY","primary":false,"unique":true,"optional":true,"components":[{"col":"CODE","asc":true}]},{"name":"DESCKEY","primary":false,"unique":false,"components":[{"col":"AMOUNT","asc":false},{"col":"ID","asc":true}]},{"name":"IDX","primary":false,"unique":false,"components":[{"col":"NAME","asc":true}]}], "complete": true }
  exit 0

cases.title: A two-column ORDER BY served by a key walked in reverse
A DECIMAL literal that needs the field's full declared width is accepted
cases.evidence:
> (CP-3) Copy-Item testdata\ALLTYPES.TPS testdata\work\ALLTYPES.TPS -Force
> tpscli.exe INSERT INTO [testdata\work\ALLTYPES.TPS] (ID, D) VALUES (50, 54321.99)
  { "ok": true, "op": "insert", "affected": 1, "complete": true }
  exit 0
> tpscli.exe SELECT ID, D FROM [testdata\work\ALLTYPES.TPS] WHERE ID = 50
  { "ok": true, "op": "select", "columns": [{"name":"ID","type":"LONG"},{"name":"D","type":"DECIMAL"}], "rows": [[50,"54321.99"]], "row_count": 1, "truncated": false, "complete": true }
  exit 0
